verdict.rationale: Fin has a first-party help article titled "Use Fin AI Agent in multiple languages", which documents multilingual support as a product capability. The pack contains only that title, with no detail on which languages are covered or how answers are produced. Nothing in the pack shows Fin answering in other languages from an English-only knowledge base. Missing for 10: evidence of answering in other languages from English-only content, a list or count of supported languages, detail on language detection and translation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent supports customers in many languages, even where my knowledge base exists only in English

citations.quote: Use Fin AI Agent in multiple languages
